fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record with an official stamp in Chinese/English. The issue date shall be after October 1, 2025. * 2. Bank deposit certificate Bank deposit certificate to prove an equivalent of CNY 50,000 or more in the account of the applicant. 3. Other supporting materials Eg. Applicants who apply to design-related majors are required to provide drawings or other materials. * 4. Self-introduction Applicants are required to upload a video of self-introduction within one minute, and those who have got HSK certificates must use Chinese to introduce themselves. The video must be in MP4 format with a capacity of less than 40MB. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate * 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Records Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirement of Physical Examination Record.pdf. An incomplete form (including sheets with no photos, no signs or stamps of doctors and hospitals) is regarded as an invalid form. The physical examination form shall be issued after October 1, 2025. The original piece is required during registration. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Photocopy of the first page of passport (Over one-year availability) * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Transcript of the highest diploma (or notarized Chinese/English translated document) * 10. Photocopy of Highest graduation certificate (or notarized Chinese/English translated document) If the applicant is currently a student, the pre-graduation certificate issued by the school is required. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Basic Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health, hold a valid foreign passport, have obtained a high school diploma, and are willing to comply with the Chinese laws and regulations of CSU. (2) Aged between 18-25 (born before May 30, 2008). Applicants who are under the age of 18(above 16) need an eligible guardian living in China. The eligible guardian should have worked in China for a long time. (3) Language requirements: Students who apply for English-taught programs should obtain a minimum score of 6 in IELTS or 85 in TOEFL. Applicants are exempt from proving language proficiency if English is their first/official language, or if they have completed a prior degree taught in English. (4) The Mandatory Assessment Subjects are detailed in 2 026 English-taught Undergraduate Programs in CSU.xlsx .
